remarks: Introducing 2 Argento Lane, a stunning newly completed home with four finished levels of luxurious construction, branded fixtures and modern finishes. The only available rental in this new, private enclave of 17 homes located in the coastal city of Norwalk, Connecticut. Enjoy maintenance free living with snow plowing, landscaping, shoveling and irrigation included. The home was professionally curated with Kohler plumbing fixtures, Quartz tops, custom built kitchen, 4" wide plank white oak floors in a natural finish, 9'+ high ceilings on ALL levels and plenty of storage. The OPEN FLOOR PLAN boasts gorgeous kitchen with center island and walk in pantry open to dining and family room with coffered ceiling, dramatic linear fireplace, and doors to patio, as well as first floor bedroom/office with full bath ensuite and walk in closet. The second floor features a spacious bonus room/office/5th bedroom, luxe master suite with 2 walk in closets, and full bath, two additional bedrooms with full bath, fully equipped laundry room and open stairway to finished floor third floor. The lower level adds an entirely new definition of entertainment with an expansive space for media, entertaining, fitness, hobby, etc. with bathroom and plenty of added storage.
